title: Alpha slate: prune dashboard cards, limit trace retention, and define minimum cost breakdown flows
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Context: For the alpha console release we must sharply reduce surface area so we can deliver a reliable, testable insights experience that demonstrates route-level cost clarity and basic trace fallback behavior. This ticket captures the decisions to prune non-essential dashboard cards, define a constrained cost breakdown flow, and impose short-term trace retention and sampling limits. Goal: ship a focused alpha that shows per-route cost tiles, a link to sampled traces with simple timeline and error highlights, and a clear list of known omitted items with acceptance tests and rollout gating. Out of scope for alpha: token-level cost breakdown, cross-route aggregation dashboards, custom user billing views, long-term trace storage, advanced trace query language, and per-token latency heatmaps.
acceptance_criteria: Route cost tile: for the top 20 routes by traffic, the dashboard shows cost, requests, avg latency, and cost per request within the alpha UI; values match billing analytics within 3% for the last 24h.
Dashboard performance: initial dashboard page load completes in <= 800ms median for seeded alpha accounts (measured on staging with 100 concurrent users).
Trace retention: backend enforces 7-day retention for alpha traces; archived traces beyond 7 days are not queryable and attempts return 404 with clear UI messaging.
Trace sampling: sampling guidance and deterministic sampling policy implemented (default: head-based, 1% global, 10% for routes with error rate > 1%) and verified in test harness.
Rollout flags: feature-flag gating exists to enable/disable cost tiles and trace links per org; default is off for all production orgs and on for alpha orgs.
Telemetry: expose three telemetry metrics for alpha — dashboard_render_ms, route_cost_sync_error, trace_sample_rate — and dashboards exist in Datadog for product/infra teams.
Docs: product alpha README and public-facing alpha notes published with clear list of omitted capabilities and upgrade path to beta.
E2E tests: automated smoke tests confirm route tiles surface expected values and trace link opens sampled trace UI for representative routes.
decisions: Prune: remove per-model and per-user breakdown cards from alpha. Keep only route-level and top-errors cards.
Trace retention limited to 7 days for alpha to reduce storage and simplify compliance review.
Sampling policy: implement simple deterministic head-based sampler with configurable thresholds rather than a full adaptive sampler for alpha.
Cost granularity: present cost-per-request and aggregated daily cost only; defer per-token and per-call leg cost to beta.
Rollout: alpha behind FF, gradually enabled for invited accounts; no mass rollout until beta.
Telemetry: include explicit sync-check metric to detect mismatches between billing pipeline and UI tiles during alpha.
Design: simplified tile UI to support quick iterations and avoid heavy data transforms on the client.
Security: no export of raw traces or cost CSVs in alpha; add in beta once RBAC and audit logs complete.
progress_updates: 2026-03-03: Kickoff with Eng/Design. Agreed on 7-day retention and route-only cost tiles.
2026-03-06: Engineering spike completed for sampling prototype; head-based sampler validated on staging traffic.
2026-03-09: Design delivered low-fidelity tiles and error highlight treatment; UX review notes added to doc.
2026-03-11: Backend endpoints to surface route-level cost created (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/3421).
2026-03-12: QA found edge case where missing billing rows cause blank tiles; fallback behavior added to acceptance criteria.
2026-03-14: Feature flags wired to alpha org list; data sync smoke tests passing at 95% in staging.
Next steps: finalize E2E tests, publish alpha notes, coordinate limited enablement with Customer Success.
known_omissions: No per-token cost or token-level latency in alpha
No long-term trace storage beyond 7 days
No CSV export or detailed user billing views
notes_for_engineering: Implement fallbacks so tiles show 'data delayed' when billing sync misses a window.
Expose a /alpha-only tracing endpoint with enforced retention TTL.
Add feature flags and include a config to toggle sampler thresholds per org.
Provide a synthetic data mode to exercise tiles without real billing data for QA.
